hassio_confirm.title: Connect to Voxl Chromium
hassio_confirm.description: The Supervisor discovered the Voxl Chromium add-on. Confirm to connect Home Assistant to its native automation API, or update the existing connection. No browser actions run during setup.

user.title: Connect to Voxl Chromium
user.description: Enter the add-on internal hostname (or IP), native API port and automation token. Do not enter a URL.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the native API.
